ov: يوم الدين هو فيلم كوميدي مصري من إخراج أبو بكر شوفي. تم اختيار الفيلم للمنافسة على السعفة الذهبية في مهرجان كان السينمائي لعام 2018.
plotEn: Beshay, a Coptic man who had leprosy, was taken by his father to a leper colony north of Cairo as a child. There he married the mentally ill Ireny. When Ireny dies, he sees her mother for the first time and realizes that he too has family. Beshay is cured of leprosy, but not of the scars: he has scars on his face, deformed hands and seems never to have grown up fully. He loads all his belongings onto a donkey cart with which he skims the garbage dump for a living and sets off for his native village near Qena. Shortly after his departure, Obama, a Nubian orphan boy, jumps on the cart. Together they travel south through Egypt, in search of what is left of his family. They are confronted with setbacks and good fortune, people who steal from them and people who help them.
